_comment: Curated stereoisomer fold map — the fold data the build consumes (Specs/stereoisomer-and-release-form-axes.md Stage A). Each variant folds into its `parent` as one substance with an isomer selector (e.g. Ketamine is one entry; Esketamine is its S-isomer, not a separate row). Auto-derived by pipeline/audit/overlay_lib.py isomer_families() from InChIKey connectivity-block clusters, then hand-vetted. `isomer` = stored stereo code (drives dedup); `displayName` = the recognized name shown in the picker title. Read at build time by Build.fold_isomer_families() (via collision_registry.fold_families()): it folds each variant under the parent, tags the moved dose/duration rows with the isomer code, and keeps variant names + brands as aliases. `synonyms` = non-brand spellings of the SAME enantiomer (INN, chemical or historical names — 'Levmetamfetamine', 'S-(+)-amphetamine', 'l-desoxyephedrine'); they get the isomer facet exactly like the variant name, but are excluded from brand-kind seeding so display never leads with a name nobody markets. Only the `name` field drives the substance fold, so brands/synonyms can never mint a row.

excluded.reason: Genuine enantiomers. The shared-key corruption is fixed in Stage 0.0a (Dextromethorphan -> MKXZASYAUGDDCJ-NJAFHUGGSA-N, Levomethorphan keeps -CGTJXYLNSA-N), but they stay EXCLUDED from folding: they are clinically distinct drugs (antitussive vs opioid) with no racemic parent row, so they remain separate substances (classified 'distinct' in inchikey-collisions.json), not one folded family.
Protonation states (charge layer N vs O), not stereoisomers. Serotonin(1+) is the cation, not a chiral variant; likely chemistry-noise that should not be a separate row.
Mescaline is achiral (no stereocenter); the '4-D'/'beta-D' rows are truncated/garbled names carrying spurious stereo layers. Investigate the names, not a fold.
Obscure AMPAkine research compounds; relationship (enantiomer vs regioisomer) unconfirmed. Needs a human call before folding.
